step.title: Match gender, number and case

step.title: Our: a worked case change

step.title: Position rather than quantity
step.body: пе́рвый — first. второ́й — second. тре́тий — third. четвёртый — fourth. An ordinal identifies position in an ordered sequence; a cardinal tells how many. These isolated ordinal forms are masculine nominative singular. Learn the position expressed by each form before choosing it.

step.title: Ordinals agree like adjectives
step.body: Ordinals agree with their noun in gender, number and case, like adjectives. восемнадцатую девушку means the eighteenth girl as a feminine accusative noun phrase. The retained example comes from a sentence about photographing her; this displayed fragment alone does not mean She just photographed. The ordinal ending follows the noun phrase, rather than staying in the masculine dictionary form. These recognition checks do not assess producing agreement in a sentence.

step.title: Work the requested position
step.body: For the first ordinal, choose пе́рвый; for the second ordinal, choose второ́й; for the third ordinal, choose тре́тий. четвёртый expresses fourth, so it fails each of those requests. Read the English request: the separately shown Russian cue may name a different position and is not the target to copy.

step.body: Read the requested position or quantity and compare the forms explained above, then choose from the displayed alternatives. A missed check returns to all explanations and examples.

step.title: Separate the letter description from the sentence action
step.body: Письмо, написанное Анной, лежит на столе. means the letter Anna wrote is on the table. The participial phrase написанное Анной describes the letter: written is the action affecting it, and Anna is the named writer. The main statement locates the letter on the table. Being written and being on the table are separate parts of the reading. Neither the table nor the letter is the writer. The sentence does not say that Anna put the letter away, and the writer is not identified as its reader. A passive participle describes the affected entity; an agent phrase can name the person responsible for that particular action.

step.title: Do not transfer the main-action subject to an unnamed participle agent
step.body: Анна убрала прочитанное письмо. means Anna put away the letter that had been read. Anna performs the putting-away action; the description прочитанное письмо says that the letter had already been read. The sentence does not name the reader. Anna might or might not have read it; neither reading can be asserted from this sentence alone. Already read is different from just written or still reading aloud. The supplied passive description expresses the completed reading of the letter, not an ongoing action by Anna. Recognize the main verb, the affected letter and any explicitly named agent separately. These checks interpret the supplied readings; accent placement alone cannot answer who wrote or read the letter, and recognizing these examples does not demonstrate production of an unfamiliar participial sentence.
